occurrences.bsb: And the rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
occurrences.kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

occurrences.bsb: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
occurrences.kjv: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

occurrences.bsb: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
occurrences.kjv: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

occurrences.bsb: Some time later, however, the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

occurrences.bsb: for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth.’”
occurrences.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”
occurrences.kjv: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

occurrences.bsb: On the seventh time the servant reported, “There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.” And Elijah replied, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’”
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

occurrences.bsb: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind or rain, but the valley will be filled with water, and you will drink—you and your cattle and your animals.’
occurrences.kjv: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

occurrences.bsb: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.
occurrences.kjv: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

occurrences.bsb: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
occurrences.kjv: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

occurrences.bsb: For He says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ and to the gentle rain, ‘Pour out a mighty downpour.’
occurrences.kjv: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

occurrences.bsb: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
occurrences.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

occurrences.bsb: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
occurrences.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

occurrences.bsb: Like clouds and wind without rain is the man who boasts of gifts never given.
occurrences.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

occurrences.bsb: As the north wind brings forth rain, so a backbiting tongue brings angry looks.
occurrences.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

occurrences.bsb: If the clouds are full, they will pour out rain upon the earth; whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there it will lie.
occurrences.kjv: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.

occurrences.bsb: before the light of the sun, moon, and stars is darkened, and the clouds return after the rain,
occurrences.kjv: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:

occurrences.bsb: For now the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
occurrences.kjv: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

occurrences.bsb: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel, and the rain makes it grow.
occurrences.kjv: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

occurrences.bsb: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
occurrences.kjv: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

occurrences.bsb: They have not said in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rains, both autumn and spring, in season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.’
occurrences.kjv: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

occurrences.bsb: The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen on the land. The farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
occurrences.kjv: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

occurrences.bsb: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
occurrences.kjv: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

occurrences.bsb: tell those whitewashing the wall that it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.
occurrences.kjv: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.

occurrences.bsb: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.
occurrences.kjv: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

occurrences.bsb: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed. I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.
occurrences.kjv: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

occurrences.bsb: So let us know—let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.
occurrences.kjv: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

occurrences.bsb: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
occurrences.kjv: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

occurrences.bsb: “I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
occurrences.kjv: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

occurrences.bsb: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
occurrences.kjv: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

occurrences.bsb: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.
occurrences.kjv: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
